thread:
Jules: FYI customer reports repeated mid-stream silence when users switch from Wi‑Fi -> cellular. They see partial JSON then connection closes.
Maya: Which SDK / platform? iOS, Android, web?
Jules: iOS 16.4 app (embedded Redwood JS SDK v0.9.2 via WKWebView). Happens on hotspot handoff and quick SSID flips.
Ash: Can we get the raw client logs + server request id? Might be a FIN/RESET from OS.
Jules: Pasted capture from their repro run (anonymized):
```
[client] 2024-06-02T14:12:03Z start stream req_id=rc_9f2a
[client] 2024-06-02T14:12:05Z recv chunk {"choices":[{"delta":{"content":"Hello, he"}}]}
[client] 2024-06-02T14:12:05Z network change -> WiFi->Cellular
[client] 2024-06-02T14:12:05Z TCP FIN sent
[client] 2024-06-02T14:12:05Z socket closed, attempting reconnect
[client] 2024-06-02T14:12:06Z reconnect -> new socket, resuming impossible, server side shows partial generation billed
[server] 2024-06-02T14:12:05Z conn rc_9f2a: stream closed (EOF)
[server] 2024-06-02T14:12:06Z gen rc_9f2a: partial output committed to usage metrics
```
Jules: Customer is concerned about partial outputs getting billed and about application behavior (UI stuck on "streaming...").
Tom: Do we have any logs showing an HTTP-level 499/504/408 or h2 RST_STREAM? The snippet shows TCP FIN but need higher layer.
Jules: From our edge (filtered):
```
edge: 2024-06-02T14:12:05.124 req_id=rc_9f2a client_ip=1.2.3.4 proto=http/2 status=200 bytes_sent=5120 
edge: 2024-06-02T14:12:05.125 connection_reset remote=1.2.3.4
edge: 2024-06-02T14:12:06.001 billing: charge_request_id=br_77aa partial_tokens=64
```
Maya: Potential root causes: client closed socket without sending SSE terminator, OS-level TCP FIN while app in background, or WKWebView tearing down socket on network handoff. iOS often aggressively closes sockets on interface change.
Ash: For repro, I want a pcap or tcpdump from device (or phoneproxied traffic). Also need user agent + exact SDK path.
Jules: Repro steps customer sent: 1) Start chat 2) type long prompt 3) quickly toggle hotspot off on phone 4) wait for reconnect -> UI shows no more chunks and user must refresh. They attached a short screen recording.
Tom: Short-term mitigation: implement idempotent resume on client: emit a resume_token (UUID) at stream start and have server accept resume requests to continue from last committed token. If not feasible, retry/refresh the UI sooner and mark partial as non-terminal to avoid UI hang.
Maya: Can also enable keepalive pings from client (every 15s) and set shorter client-side network timeouts so app detects dead socket faster and/or attempts HTTP reconnect before OS kills socket.
Ash: On server we can delay committing partial output to billing by 5s window to allow resume. Not a long-term billing change but a possible emergency flag for this customer. I'll check if we can set a per-customer billing grace.
Jules: Customer asks for minimal repro app. Maya, can you share small WKWebView SSE snippet that handles reconnect and resume?
Maya: Sure — sample pseudocode they can drop in:
```
const resumeToken = uuidv4();
const es = new EventSource(`${API_URL}/v1/stream?resume_token=${resumeToken}`);
es.onmessage = (e) => { renderChunk(e.data) }
es.onerror = () => { setTimeout(() => attemptResume(), 500) }
function attemptResume() { fetch(`/v1/stream/resume?token=${resumeToken}`).then(...) }
```
Add checks for `readyState` and `visibilitychange` to avoid background kills.
Tom: I'll pull edge traces for rc_9f2a and see if we have h2 error codes (RST_STREAM vs GOAWAY). Also check whether KV cache was released on server side (might explain partial commit).
deploy-bot: deploy started: feature/stream-resume-grace -> canary (region us-east-1)
Jules: Thanks — customer willing to test a canary. If we can flip a per-customer grace (delay billing commit for 5s on disconnect with resume token), that'd be ideal.
Ash: I'll open an internal ticket and flag for billing policy review. Repro next steps: request pcap, SDK stack traces, try with Safari (non-WKWebView) and Android to isolate.
Jules: I'll collect the capture + screen recording and ask them to test the canary. Noted: prioritize mobile handoff cases.
Maya: Also add a KB blurb: "Intermittent mid-stream disconnects during mobile network handoff" with suggested client settings: keepalives, resume token, short client timeout, and UX fallback to show "partial result — tap to continue".
Tom: If the canary looks good, we can roll a 1‑minute billing grace toggle for affected customers.
Jules: Great. I'll update customer and paste the canary link when available. :thumbsup:
